experiment_card: A1a — Fixed-budget vocabulary selection (CPU development only)

decode_latency_dev_us.basis_note: zstd measured in-process via C libzstd (40 reps/file); A1AF/A1AD measured via standalone pure-Python independent_decode.py.

dual_header_serializer_and_independent_d.detail: All 70 dual-archive (140 A1AF/A1AD) builds + emit_mask archives verified 100% byte-for-byte via standalone independent_decode.py.

negative_corruption_controls.detail: All 6 corruption controls (DAG self-edge, DAG valid-index edge swap, merge rank inversion, duplicate rank, Huffman Kraft corruption, flat payload bitflip) rejected.

bmax1_exact_identity.detail: b_max=1 slot reproduced exact-closed 4096/4096 (0 diffs, 225.62s); b_max=1 byte reproduced pair-byte 2822/2822 (0 diffs, extended to 8710 entries, 363.184s).

synthetic_shared_ancestor_bundle_mechani.detail: Verified exact engine_shared_bundle accepts single-root straddled bundle ({ba, baaba}, gain=15/2=7.5 > 5) and multi-root shared-ancestor bundle ({ba, baaba, baabx}, gain=40/3=13.33 > 12.5 > 10) charging shared ancestor once.

bundle_training_dev_gate_flat_literal_by.detail: At historical flat-literal fragment budgets (566 B and 43,480 B), shared-bundle-byte accepted 0 multi-node bundles on CodeNet primary (573,831 exact joint-DP bundle evals) and coincided with exact pair-byte: +4.86% at 566 B and +6.53% at 43,480 B vs open-byte (tolerance <= +2.00%; 0.00% vs pair-byte).

bundle_training_dev_gate_matched_emitted.detail: At matched emitted slots (84 and 3,924 fragments), shared-bundle-slot/dag coincided with exact-closed: +14.55% and +24.77% vs open (slot-tax corollary), while using 31.1% and 54.1% smaller A1AD headers.

common_dag_serializer_repriced_dev_gate.detail: Under common A1AD construction-DAG header budgets (878 B and 33,241 B matching open@84 and open@3924), shared-bundle-dag (= exact-closed, 0 multi-bundle accepts) beats pair-byte by -2.54% / -5.42% AND beats the better open reference (open-byte) by -1.30% / -1.87% at BOTH budgets. Honest attribution: this pass is caused by A1AD DAG header repricing removing the flat-literal length tax, NOT multi-node bundle firing.

ancestor_diagnostics_and_emission_ablati.detail: Measured purchased/shared/emitted/unused ancestors and individual+joint emission disabling retaining the storage DAG (A1AD emit_mask verified). Disabling promoted ancestors increases unseen dev tokens by +107.88% (slots_large) to +141.09% (dag_header_large), proving ancestors are load-bearing fallback pieces.

norm_pruning_equivalence_and_timing.detail: 0/4096 full-chain differences vs exact-norm-s1-whole.txt; wall-clock 302.627s (including 0.279s U(w) maintenance) vs 628.49s (2.08x speedup). Proved & verified min_i Delta_T(t_i t_{i+1}) + U(w) >= used(w) identically (0 violations).

hf_tokenizers_live_validation.detail: Live tokenizers 0.22.2 verified: reachable, shadowed-unreachable, missing-parent controls, and 100% byte round-trip + exact merge replay match on CodeNet dev.

tiktoken_byte_rank_validation.detail: Pure-Python tiktoken byte-rank reachability validator passed all controls and audits; live tiktoken runtime check skipped because `tiktoken` package is not installed in .venv or system Python

zstd_lean_framed_comparison.detail: Lean-framed zstd-19 (8 KiB dict) achieves 90,622 B complete (p95=1.70 us) on dev vs best A1AD 97,414 B (exact-closed@slots_large, payload 82,155 B < zstd 82,430 B, break-even M*=6.91 MB / 10,205 files; shared-bundle-dag@dag_header_large payload 81,059 B breaks even at M*=4.94 MB / 7,297 files).
